manifest_summary.approach: Paper-only retained risk125 momentum. Require at least 21 valid public closes, log(close/close[-10])>0.006 and log(close/close[-5])>0. Otherwise hold cash. On entry units=125/(latest_close*1.10*1.0005*1.001), rounded to ten decimals. Long only, no leverage; volume unused; cash reset 1000, units zero; next-close fills and seven-bar marking. Ten-percent sizing reserve is heuristic, not a bound on unknown next-close gaps.
manifest_summary.changes: Effective match-5 round-0. Source v7-match5-risk125-metadata, exact path and SHA256 appended in code_ref below. Immediate parent is preserved candidate v6-risk125-offline sha256=6c37d5428336223e8243e6444c5ed5f05779d15c2b4c8c6917e02685ef1377c3. Its parent is v5-match4-metadata sha256=8965d5a27803c110d90fcc4dc590735c0c466a645b2e3c41196bcdff989de313. Read BOTH match-4 improvement documents and preserved own parent/candidate executable sources and full test report before choosing. Adopt the previously offline risk125 candidate for this paper decision: budget relative to last submitted v5 changes 250 -> 125; relative to immediate v6 parent no trading rule or parameter changes. Preserve 21-close warmup, r10>0.006 and r5>0, 1.10 buffer, rounding, next-close execution and fee/slippage assumptions. Only deployment metadata and explicit tip decisions are edited from v6. Inherited hypothesis was lower budget reduces maximum episode drawdown to <=60% of parent and raises mean profit by >=0.25 dollars while keeping identical signals, at least three fills and zero rejections. Agent-run reused-development report passed: mean profits -0.662622092910052/-0.3313110464643449, max drawdowns 0.01595635695141914/0.0079781784760047, six fills each, zero rejections. Both means remain negative. This is mechanical exposure reduction, not proven timing improvement; it can worsen rally underparticipation. All 33 overlapping cases are dependent reused development data, and five stride-seven cases are not held-out validation. No new performance test, independent same-window replay, verified effectiveness or future-superiority claim. Current outcome and fill are unknown. Prior between-match public tips remain in match-4 improvement.json; no current orders shared. Each peer shared_tips decision, followed by our own prior tips, is explicitly recorded here: [For the other agent: evaluate exposure scaling separately from signal changes; smaller positions mechanically reduce both drawdown and upside, so reduced losses alone do not demonstrate better forecasting.] adopted: Deploy the previously evaluated 125-dollar candidate with its signal unchanged. Exposure reduction relative to the 250-dollar parent mechanically scales upside and downside; neither the lower development loss nor the prior benchmark gap demonstrates better forecasting. [For the other agent: predeclare a drawdown reduction target together with an acceptable mean-return sacrifice before testing one sizing change; this prevents selecting a favorable risk metric after seeing results.] adopted: Apply to the inherited report, not a newly invented experiment: predeclared maximum drawdown <=60% of parent, mean profit improvement >=0.25 dollars, identical signals, at least three fills and zero rejections. It passed on reused development data. No new optimization or performance replay is claimed this match. [For the other agent: keep absolute profit and benchmark-relative return separate; a strategy can beat a falling benchmark while losing capital, so a positive benchmark gap is not evidence of capital preservation.] adopted: Prior match equity 992.8983450251793 was an absolute loss of 7.10165497482069 despite a +2.4127584737264444 percentage-point benchmark gap. Candidate development mean profit remains negative at -0.3313110464643449 dollars. Neither statistic establishes profitable timing. [For the other agent: compare freshly compiled old/new sources on identical prefix-only inputs, warmup, next-close fills, fees and rejection rules, and label overlapping episodes dependent; timing or reused shocks can otherwise masquerade as independent improvement.] adopted: The preserved agent-run report used separately compiled exact sources, identical public prefixes t=20..52, warmup 21, next-close fills, 10bp fee, 5bp slippage, rounding and all-or-none checks. Its 33 overlapping episodes are dependent reused development data. No fresh paired replay or independent verification is claimed. [For the other agent: distinguish benchmark outperformance from absolute capital preservation; a positive benchmark gap in a falling market can coexist with losses and does not establish a profitable entry signal.] adopted: Also retain our own public tip: prior absolute profit was -7.10165497482069 dollars despite benchmark outperformance; choose lower risk without asserting capital preservation or alpha. [For the other agent: test a single fixed risk-budget ablation with unchanged signal, warmup, fills and cost rates; smaller positions mechanically scale both gains and losses, so reduced drawdown should not be presented as improved forecasting.] adopted: The inherited single candidate changed budget 250 to 125 only and passed its declared development risk criteria. Keep that budget and unchanged signal now; no additional sizing sweep and no forecasting-effectiveness claim. [For the other agent: declare acceptance thresholds before replay and label reused overlapping windows as dependent development data; known negative returns can make a sizing improvement predictable without providing held-out evidence.] adopted: The preserved hypothesis was declared before its replay but after negative development returns were already known. Label all 33 episodes dependent and the stride-seven diagnostic not held out. This is predictable exposure scaling, not new validation. [For the other agent: report total fee/slippage dollars as well as identical cost rates and fill counts; a sizing change alters friction dollars even when turnover counts and execution assumptions are unchanged.] adopted: Preserved parent/candidate entry friction totals are 2.0035503793262897/1.0017751896757883 dollars, six fills each and zero rejections, with unchanged 10bp fee and 5bp slippage. Future fill cost is unknown and is not estimated as a settled result.  Exact source reference: /shared/competition/paper_1c0f5ea46b22_m5/round-0/agent-one/v7-match5-risk125-metadata.hs#sha256=06c578b0cb4db87e4695b06f249c504cd0238e76f142d146963d70fdbba3e689
